    DepositIntoAdjacentStackRule
    Modifier plus an item, clicking a face of some other block that has a Singles or Bar Stack against it, deposits into that stack.

    Modifier plus an item deposits into the stack that was clicked, whatever placement mode is selected.

    An unmodified right-click on any stack takes from the nearest occupied cell along the player's reach ray.
    InteractionContext
    One right-click, in the terms the rules ask about: who clicked, what they hit, which modifiers were held, and the placement mode in force.

    One loader-neutral player gesture.
    InteractionRuleRegistry
    The ordered rule lists behind each loader's right-click callbacks, one list per kind of click.
    ModeCycleRule
    Modifier plus a right-click at open air cycles the placement mode.
    PlaceAdjacentGenericRule
    Modifier plus an item, on a click no deposit rule claimed, places the selected stack type in the position against the clicked face and makes the first deposit into it.
    RotateBlockWithRedstoneTorchRule
    Shift plus a redstone torch rotates a Storage or Singles Stack's layout 90 degrees.
    RotateItemWithSoulTorchRule
    Shift plus a soul torch rotates one rendered item within a Singles Stack, leaving the block's own layout alone.
    TogglePermanentRule
    Modifier plus an empty-handed right-click on a Storage Stack, in Toggle Permanent mode, switches automatic removal for the whole pile.
